Message:
If those buds bloomed,
my friend would die—
I just knew it.

The vines gripped
tightly to her skin,
so I couldn’t pull them off.

My only choice was to let
the flower-like growths on me
drain the life from
the vines themselves...

But was that possible?
What if I ended up
draining her life, too...?

At that moment,
I felt my friend gently
take my hand in her own.

I quickly tried to shake her off,
but she just smiled at me
like she always had.

I can’t let her die!
Besides, I haven’t even
apologized to her yet!

I don’t want to lose
the only friend
who stood beside me
until the very end!

So this time,
this time for sure!
By my own will, I...!

A bright light overflowed
from our joined hands...

and the flowers all over my body
burst into bloom.
